meta.scale: One unit of the 1000x600 deck-plan viewBox is 0.35 m. The deck plans are schematic, so the factor is set by room size rather than by the ship’s overall length.
meta.origin: Ship midpoint: SVG (500, 300). +x is starboard, +z is aft, +y is up.
meta.note: Horizontal doorways are derived from shared walls at load time and are not stored here. Only vertical links carry an explicit position.
